in_marathi.name: Avantika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Desirable, Lovable, Pleasing
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avantika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avantika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘avanti’ which means 'desirable' or 'lovable'. The suffix ‘ka’ signifies a female form. The name is often associated with the goddess Avantika, who is considered the embodiment of pleasing and beautiful qualities.
